usual_baseline: Driving status is recorded in a minority: 5% [3523], 17.7–18% [3345, 3372], 25% [3595, 3652], 29.1% [3517], 42% [3189]. Vehicle type is almost never asked (0–33%) [3207, 3372]. Advice at discharge is rarer still: 1 of 20 [3571], 5% [3204], 0–7% [3592]. Where drivers are identified, advice is often given (67%) [3372, 3595].
fix_that_works: A driving field in the assessment or ward round template, usually with prompts and teaching. Status 25% to 85% [3595]; 25% to 90.9% [3652]; advice 29.1% to 81.7% with MDT checklist and leaflets [3517]; 17.7% to 56.0% [3345]; median 60% to 83% [3528]. DVLA advice on discharge summaries 5% to 56% [3204].
fix_that_fails: Teaching and written guidance: 42% to 47% [3189]. Presenting results to the MDT: advice 0–7% to 21–27%, below the 50% target [3592]. Status can improve while advice lags: 50% status but advice 13.6% [3523]; advice varied weekly with no run chart shift [3528]. Insurer advice fell 45% to 0% [3419].
consultant_advice: Heavily overdone, with the same low baseline and the same template fix. Do not audit whether status is recorded again. Audit whether confirmed drivers get specific advice and DVLA duty explained, or whether a template field is still used a year on.
